bio: This is light years from your run-of-the-mill seaside brasserie! The opulent décor will bowl you over, as will the mixologist who rustles up intriguing cocktails behind the bar. Each dish overflows with generosity and is crafted by gifted, veteran chefs who work with the best ingredients. A range of dishes to share and wholesome brasserie fare. Why not start with a fresh, spicy, acidic ceviche of seabass, before pursuing with a royal vol-au-vent served with piping hot crunchy French fries? THE landmark brasserie of Nieuwpoort!...
